text:
Dana (People Ops): Quick alert 12: Dr. Chen (external speaker) arriving ~3:15pm with a large framed mirror (fragile, wide) for the atrium install + a guest (mobility OK but prefers quiet). ALSO: theres a surprise cake delivery scheduled for 3:05pm for the ops team in the kitchen. Can we coordinate storage for the mirror crate (too wide for locker), manual badge fallback (kiosk sometimes times out), and a quiet seating spot near the north alcove for the guest? Avoid placing the cake in the atrium area if possible. Thanks! :tada::sparkles:

Sam (Front Desk): Copy. Kiosk photo step is intermittently timing out on my screen. I can do manual badges. Mirror crate will need flat storage 1 like hallway staging C. Cake should go to Pantry 2 unless someone objects.

ParcelDrone: ALERT: oversized delivery ETA 3:10pm, descriptor: "framed mirror crate", fragility: high. Driver note: requires 2-person carry.

CakeBot: SCHEDULED: Surprise cake delivery at 3:05pm to Kitchen A. Note: cake box width 18in. Do you want me to request fridge space? Reply yes/no.

Riley: I can meet the courier and have two people to carry the mirror to Hallway Staging C (near Facilities door). Ill also label it "DrChen - install - fragile".

Dana (People Ops): Great Riley. Please tag the crate and leave a note: "INSTALL: hang center atrium - bracket in lid". For seating: north alcove bench with low lamp is best. Cake: please keep in Pantry 2 fridge until after talk (no open sugar near the art).

Sam (Front Desk): Manual badge fallback (if kiosk down):
```
# manual badge quick flow
/srv/frontcam/capture --out /tmp/visitor.jpg --quality 70
/usr/local/bin/makebadge --name "Dr. Chen" --role "Speaker" --photo /tmp/visitor.jpg --ttl 6h > /tmp/drchen_badge.pdf
lp -d Badge_Printer /tmp/drchen_badge.pdf
```
I'll also provision a one-day guest_wlan token and set door access to "main-floor, atrium".

BadgePrinterBot: NOTICE - low ribbon at 2:58pm, switching to draft print mode.

ParcelDrone: UPDATE: courier arrived 3:08pm. Waiting at front desk.

Sam (Front Desk): Printer jam at 3:09pm (paper feed). Trying to clear - will update.

Riley: Courier signed, crate moved to Hallway Staging C with two people. Labeled and taped. Left sticky: "bracket in lid - hang center atrium".

CakeBot: UPDATE: cake dropped at 3:05pm into Kitchen A. Fridge available, reserved slot #3. Marked "do not open until 3:55pm".

Sam (Front Desk): Cleared jam and restarted printer. Draft badges printing now. :white_check_mark:

Dana (People Ops): Seating poll for Dr. Chen's guest (reply with emoji):
:bench: north alcove bench (quieter)
:chair: small side-seat by meeting room B (closer to restroom)

Riley: :bench: north alcove bench works, moved a cushion and small side table.

Sam (Front Desk): Dr. Chen arrived 3:14pm, ID verified, badge printed (draft), guest seated in north alcove with water. Mirror crate in Hallway Staging C. Cake secured in Pantry 2 fridge slot #3. All good.

Dana (People Ops): Thanks team 1Added note: "bracket in lid" to facilities install ticket and pinged AV for hanging slot after the talk. Closing thread 1appreciate the quick coordination :raised_hands:
